column1: # *** A TENTH LERENA DISPENSATION, AND ANOTHER CHILD OF AVELINO. ***
# Catedral Basilica de Montevideo, 3 February 1892. Officiant: Presbitero Don Martin Perez, by
# licence of the Cura Parroco; signed Rafael Yeregui. Ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-R32C-K, full-text transcript
# read 14 September 2026.
field
Groom
column2: *** "Don ALFREDO GERENA, natural de esta Republica, soltero, de TREINTA Y CINCO anos de edad, hijo legitimo de Don AVELINO LORENA y Dona AMBROSIA TRAIBEL" ***
column3: *** A SON OF AVELINO, born about 1857 - a BROTHER of Josefa Lerena Traibel. *** Note the two spellings in one sentence: the groom GERENA, his father LORENA.

column1: Bride
column2: Dona HERMENEGILDA CAROLINA GAVARRO, de la misma nacionalidad y estado, de treinta anos, hija legitima de Don Geronimo Gavarro y Dona Carolina Juarez

column1: *** The dispensation ***
column2: *** "dispensados por el Ilustrisimo y Rmo Senor Obispo Diocesano Monsenor Doctor Don MARIANO SOLER del impedimento canonico de parentesco de TERCER GRADO DE CONSANGUINIDAD CON ATINGENCIA AL SEGUNDO, por linea colateral desigual" ***
column3: *** THE BRIDE AND GROOM WERE COUSINS. *** Granted personally by Mariano Soler - the first Archbishop of Montevideo, and the most senior churchman in the country.

column1: Witnesses
column2: fueron testigos Don Carlos Navia y *** Dona AMBROSIA TRAIBEL ***
column3: *** His mother stood witness at his wedding, so she was alive in February 1892. ***

column1: # ================== WHY THIS IS A TENTH, AND WHY IT WAS MISSED ==================
# This archive's sweep of the Montevideo dispensation register recorded EIGHT Lerena dispensations
# and concluded that every Lerena in it married OUT. A NINTH was found earlier today - Ema Sixta's,
# missed because the formula "LERENA FELIGRESA" cannot see a compound surname.
# *** THIS IS A TENTH, AND IT WAS MISSED TWO WAYS AT ONCE. ***
#   1. The groom is written *** GERENA ***, not Lerena - a seventh spelling for this family, after
#      Lerena, Llerena, Lorena, Serena, Lerina and Sancio. A search on LERENA cannot reach him.
#   2. The dispensation clause comes BEFORE the names, so "Lerena el impedimento" - the sweep's other
#      formula, which assumes the surname precedes the word - cannot match either.
# *** SO THE HEADLINE FINDING OF THAT FILE IS NOW TWICE BREACHED IN ONE DAY *** and its count of
# eight is certainly low. What survives is narrower and still worth something: no LERENA-LERENA
# dispensation has been found. This one is a Lerena marrying a GAVARRO.
# *** AND IT SHOWS THE FAMILY DID MARRY KIN. *** Third degree with atingencia to the second is a
# first-cousins-once-removed sort of relationship. The standing question behind this archive's whole
# search is whether Juan Carlos Lerena and Maria Lerena were kin; this does not answer it, but it
# establishes that in this generation, in this family, cousin marriage happened and was dispensed at
# the highest level.
